name: User Ratings 1.0.2.0, the Settings tab in the TV layout: in the default sandbox as admin in jellyfin-web 10.11.5's TV layout: the Settings tab has no select; the D-pad moves the focus between its controls; OK flips a switch and flips it back; OK on Save opens the dry run's dialog with the focus on Cancel; Down past the last control and Up past the first keep the focus inside it (no wrap, no way out); Back (keyCode 461) closes it with the focus back on Save, the page where it was and nothing saved; OK on Save, Down and OK on the dialog's Save save it, the focus back on Save. Every setting as it began at the end.

steps.name: the settings before the run
steps.script: const r = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Settings'); if (r.status !== 200) { throw new Error('settings ' + r.status); } return r.json;

steps.name: the settings this run changes are at their defaults
steps.assert: (() => { const s = __vars.before.Settings; return s.EnableRatings === true && s.EnableReviews === true && s.WhoCanRate === 'AllUsers' && s.RaterUserIds.length === 0 && s.RateableItemTypes.indexOf('Movie') >= 0 && s.RateableItemTypes.indexOf('Trailer') < 0 && s.EnableTopRatedPage === true && s.MirrorToUserData === false && s.ReviewsPageSize < 50 && s.MaxReviewLength < 20000 && s.MinRatingsForAverage < 10 && s.SnapshotsToKeep < 365 && s.DetachedRetentionDays < 36500 && s.ModerationLogDays < 3650; })()
steps.message: start with the defaults for EnableRatings, EnableReviews, WhoCanRate (AllUsers, nobody chosen), RateableItemTypes (Movie in, Trailer out), EnableTopRatedPage and MirrorToUserData, and every number under its largest

steps.name: viewer's and viewer2's ids
steps.eval: (() => { const u = __vars.before.Users; const v = u.find(x => x.Name === 'viewer'), w = u.find(x => x.Name === 'viewer2'); return v && w ? { viewer: v.Id, viewer2: w.Id } : null; })()

steps.name: clean: before the run: every rating on Long Test Movie removed through the moderation API
steps.script: const page = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Reviews?itemId=' + __vars.movieId + '&limit=200'); if (page.status !== 200) { throw new Error('list ' + page.status); } const removed = []; for (const row of page.json.Items) { const p = 'UserRatings/Admin/Reviews/' + row.RatingId + '?textOnly=false'; const dry = await __jfurDetails.server('DELETE', p); const done = await __jfurDetails.server('DELETE', p + '&dryRun=false&ifPreview=' + dry.json.PreviewToken); removed.push(done.status); } return removed;

steps.script: const canon = (v) => Array.isArray(v) ? JSON.stringify(v.map(x => String(x).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase()).sort()) : JSON.stringify(v); const now = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Settings'); const change = {}; for (const k of Object.keys(__vars.before.Settings)) { if (canon(now.json.Settings[k]) !== canon(__vars.before.Settings[k])) { change[k] = __vars.before.Settings[k]; } } if (Object.keys(change).length > 0) { const r = await __jfurDetails.server('POST', 'UserRatings/Admin/Settings?version=' + now.json.Version + '&dryRun=false', change); if (r.status !== 200) { throw new Error('restore ' + r.status + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r.json)); } } const after = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Settings'); return { changed: Object.keys(change), same: Object.keys(__vars.before.Settings).every(k => canon(after.json.Settings[k]) === canon(__vars.before.Settings[k])) };
